title: Per-Window Toolbar Strip
description:
Every window receives its own toolbar strip on the bottom (same as footer but floating and glassy like window options). Tools are now on window level. In the footer should only remain app mode wide commands.

Implementation: add a `toolbar` slot to `Window`/`WindowConfig` in ui/js/react/index.tsx, styled as a full-width floating glass strip at the bottom of the window body (windowOptions glass tier, no rounded corners), foldable with the same chrome pattern as WindowMeasuresChrome/WindowEngagementChrome, folded chip anchored bottom-left. Rewire framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx to source tools per window kind (toolNodesByKind via plugin.tools called per windowKindId) instead of one global activeToolNodes, pass each window its own ToolTree via the new toolbar slot, and strip the ToolTree/tools out of footerToolbar so the footer only keeps the app label item and the app-wide SyncAttachCard/sync tools. Update ui/styling/js/ui.css with a matching glass rule for the new data-slot, and extend Window.stories.tsx / Footer.stories.tsx and the existing test suites (framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts, in-source Window tests) accordingly. No rounded corners anywhere in the new/touched classes per repo design rule.
summary: Moved tools from the app-wide footer to a per-window floating toolbar strip. Added a `toolbar` slot to `Window`/`WindowConfig` in ui/js/react/index.tsx: a full-width, bottom-anchored, glassy (windowOptions tier, no rounded corners) strip with the same foldable chrome pattern as the Window Options/Command rails (new `WindowToolbarChrome`, folds to a bottom-left chip). Added matching CSS glass rule for `[data-slot="window-toolbar"]`. Rewired framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx: `activeToolNodes` replaced by `toolNodesByKind` (tools now sourced per window kind via `plugin.tools(instanceId, { ...viewState, activeWindowKindId: kind.id })`), new `windowToolbarNode` helper wires each window's own ToolTree (with a namespaced id `ui.toolbar.<windowId>` to avoid DOM id collisions across simultaneously-rendered windows), applied to base/extra/spawned windows. `footerToolbar` stripped down to only the app-wide SyncAttachCard; `footerItems` unchanged (app label). Extended Window.stories.tsx (WithToolbar, WithControlsMeasuresEngagementAndToolbar stories), relabeled Footer.stories.tsx toolbar content as app-wide/sync. Extended tests: 2 new Window fold/render tests in ui/js/react/index.tsx, 1 new ToolTree custom-id test in framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts — all passing (36/36 Window tests, 29/29 framework-renderer-react tests). Also fixed two pre-existing duplicate-import bugs in .storybook/preview.ts (duplicate `React` and `Decorator` imports) discovered while trying to verify visually; Storybook itself remains blocked by a separate, unrelated, pre-existing global crash (flagged as a follow-up task) affecting every story regardless of content, so final visual verification relied on the passing unit test suites instead. Created .claude/launch.json with a storybook dev entry (used for verification attempts).
